newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India expected to issue Dec kero tender next week.
newsitem.headline: India expected to issue Dec kero tender next week.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) is expected to issue a tender to buy superior kerosene for deliveries in December within the next five to seven days, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender will seek the usual 30,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Goa or Kandla on the Indian west coast, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
It will also seek 45,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the east coast, c-and-f.
The tender is expected to close by end-October or early November, the source said.
In its last tender, India bought one 45,000-tonne cargo of kerosene for November delivery from U.S. major Mobil at a $2.08 per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f east coast.
